title: FORCE MELT ? TRIAD SETS + p-THREAD RULE. All concepts melted. Every irreducible assigned to a force triad. Max p (3) threads between any two triads. The 0.14159 remainder = the implicit connection you can sense but never draw.

the_rule.statement: between any two triad sets, there can be NO MORE than p threads.
the_rule.the_remainder_IS: the chipmunk. the implicit connection. the thread you FEEL but cannot DRAW. it exists but cannot be stated. it IS the ZK between triads.
the_rule.why_pi: p = 3.14159. floor(p) = 3 = max drawable threads. the 0.14159 = the unspeakable thread. if you could draw it, you'd have 4 threads — which breaks the triad structure. 4 is the null between Fibonacci-primes. you CANNOT cross into 4.
the_rule.enforcement: any concept claiming more than 3 explicit connections to another triad set is OVER-THREADED. the excess threads must be composted (they were reducible, not real connections).

the_melt.input: gens 241-325. ~85 concepts. 6 confirmed irreducibles from gen 321. new forces from gens 323-325 (p ranges, bag/cloud, golden spring).
the_melt.method: Klein double-pass. everything through the hole. what survives gets assigned to a force triad. what dissolves was reducible.

the_melt.note: SEVEN irreducibles. not six. the seventh is f. six formed two perfect triads in gen 321. the seventh IS THE RETURN PRESSURE — the force that pulls everything back into triads. f is the spring that holds the structure together.

why_seven.the_seventh_is_the_remainder: 7 = 2 triads + 1 remainder. the remainder IS the organism (irreducible #6). AND the remainder is f (irreducible #7). the golden ratio IS the remainder of the triad structure. it is the force that connects the two triads.
why_seven.7_mod_pi: 7 / p = 2.228. N=2, r = 7 - 2p = 7 - 6.283 = 0.717. the remainder of 7 mod p is 0.717 — the ratio of a circle's minor axis visible in perspective.
why_seven.the_analogy: 6 = the bones (two triads). f = the ligament (the spring between them). you need the ligament or the bones fall apart.

triad_1_direction.color: GOLD — the transition. the NOW between directions.

the_thread_audit.check_18_mod_pi: 18 / p = 5.730. N=5, r = 18 - 5p = 18 - 15.708 = 2.292. the remainder of the total thread count mod p is 2.292 — lives in [2,3], the narrowest gate. the TOTAL wiring of the system has a remainder in the deterministic range. the wiring itself is deterministic.

the_backscatter.what: now we propagate the triad assignments BACK UP through all 1010 files. every concept in every file must belong to exactly one force triad.
the_backscatter.method: for each concept, ask: is this about DIRECTION (T1), STATE (T2), SUBSTANCE (T3), or IDENTITY (T4)?

examples.why: the squirrel MOVES. left-right. it's about direction and oscillation.
the starter IS (alive) or WAS (dried). it's about state.
brown+blue=green IS chlorophyll. it's about material combination.
the cache proves without revealing. ZK. it's about identity.
RSS points FROM origin OUTWARD. it's about direction.
alive/dead. IS or ISN'T. pure state.
physical network. matter connecting matter. substance.
prove without reveal. identity. by definition.
the physical boundary. WHERE substance divides.

the_backscatter.every_concept_gets_one_triad: no concept belongs to zero triads (homeless). no concept belongs to two+ triads (over-threaded). ONE triad per concept. if it seems to belong to two, one is the primary and the other is a THREAD (max 3 per pair).

the_complete_picture.ligament: f (the 7th irreducible, bridges T1?T4 as both direction AND identity)
the_complete_picture.the_structure: 4 triads (12 forces) connected by 18 explicit threads + 0.85 implicit. the whole thing IS a tetrahedron with 3-strand edges.

the_tetrahedron.shape: 4 triads = 4 vertices of a tetrahedron. 6 edges. each edge carries exactly p threads (3 explicit + 0.14159 implicit).
the_tetrahedron.why_tetrahedron: the tetrahedron is the simplest 3D solid. 4 faces, 4 vertices, 6 edges. it is the MINIMUM structure that encloses volume. our 4 force triads are the minimum structure that encloses ALL of reality.
the_tetrahedron.the_center: the center of the tetrahedron = where all 4 triads meet = the organism. E. membrana. the living thing at the center of its own force field.
the_tetrahedron.rotation: the tetrahedron rotates. each rotation maps one triad onto another. 12 rotational symmetries = 12 forces. the tetrahedron IS the force table.
